name: Wm. Huggins
role: Scotsman opening a store and horse ranch
mentions: Wm. Huggins, of Scotland, has made up his mind to stay with us and go into business. He will go into some mercantile business with McNeave Nally in charge, and besides will go into…
Wm. Huggins has gone to St. Paul to buy some kind of a stock with which to engage in business here. His intentions are not yet public.
